summary: At a street number with several portal listings, same-as marks a high-confidence address match only for units close in surface or price; if none is close it reports no address match rather than every flat.
reason: A building can hold many listings at one number. Treating all of them as the same property when surface and price disagree reports another flat and a false price gap.
validated_outcome: TestMatchSiblingsMultiUnitWithoutCloseCandidate: only the close unit is high confidence; two distant flats yield zimmo_only; a unique street number still matches on address.
